structured_output.summary: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(3) lets a filer claim a refundable credit for taxable years 2025 and 2026. The credit equals 20% of the federal § 32 EITC and is taken in place of the nonrefundable low-income credit and the nonrefundable EITC. The head is 40 and has no children, so the federal EITC is 7.65% × $520 = $39.78, which gives $7.96 for Virginia. The engine's steps match this, and stage 1 reached the same figure. The consensus answer of $0 rests on the wrong belief that the credit is nonrefundable or has expired. The only open point is rounding: the IRS lookup table gives an EITC of $40, which would make the Virginia credit $8.00.
